* '''PC-E1''' ([[Ap'lek (Errata)]]): Slip on the Players Committee's Virtual Set 22 release sheet<ref name="sheet22-20231006">Players Committee, [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-22.pdf Virtual Set 22 release sheet] (PDF, 5 pages, footer “SWCCG Players Committee, October 2023”; file created 6 October 2023). Released with [[Virtual Set 22]] (2 October 2023); the PDF is dated by its creation date.</ref>, page 1, file created 6 October 2023: “Adds one battle destiny. If opponent initiates battle here, retrieve 1 Force and add its destiny number to Ap'lek's power, or power of Night Buzzard he is piloting. End of your turn: Use 1 Force to maintain OR Place out of play.” '''What changed:''' Same words as [[Ap'lek]] (Original). The sheet reprints the PC card image of [[Ap'lek]] (published 2 October 2023) as a printable slip under the label “•Ap’lek”; the card itself is pixel for pixel that image (the sheet leaves off the image file's top strip). A separate Players Committee publication, so its own version (Bill, 11 and 12 November 2026: every publication is a version; a release-sheet slip and the PC card image are separate printings). '''Errata mark:''' the slip prints no errata mark, but it is errata 1 in release order; recorded as printed and listed as a [[Players Committee transcription errors|PC transcription error]] (Bill, 12 November 2026).

If opponent initiates battle here, retrieve 1 Force and add its destiny number to Ap’lek’s power, or power of Night Buzzard he is piloting. End of your turn: Use 1 Force to maintain OR Place out of play.” '''What changed:''' The words are unchanged. The round faction icon at top left was redrawn (the first image shows a solid ring, the re-made image thin red spokes). No errata mark. It is a version of its own because the PC published a visibly different card image (Bill, 12 November 2026: every visible change on a PC image is its own version). The card image prints no errata mark.
